about_the_game:
🚀 The Flux image model is a next-gen model we've optimized for high quality image generation.

Compared to the default included model (Stable Diffusion 1.5 based), Flux offers:

  • 🎯 Improved image quality, particularly in textures, faces, hands, and background objects.

  • ⚖️ Improved composition balance, reducing artifacts and strange object placement.

  • 🧠 Better Instruction Following which means you will see more details from your story page in the output image.

  • 🎭 Better understanding of abstract prompts, making it more expressive for surreal or conceptual artwork.

💾 The Flux Model DLC is 16GB, so make sure you have enough disk space and enough system resources (*important!) to run this model.

⚠️ *This model will use approximately 7GB of VRAM as well as an additional 10GB of regular system RAM.

content_descriptors.notes: Neverending AI Storybook generates dynamic, interactive stories based on player input, with strict guardrails to ensure content remains appropriate. The AI does not generate sexually explicit material or extreme content. If inappropriate input is detected, the AI will either redirect the story to a safe narrative or refuse to generate content altogether. This ensures a safe and respectful storytelling experience for all players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.5 Ghz
  • Graphics: 12GB+ Dedicated VRAM (2020+ discrete gaming GPU with Vulkan support)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 3.5 Ghz
  • Graphics: 16GB+ Dedicated VRAM (2020+ discrete gaming GPU with Vulkan support)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 16 GB available space

short_description: Meet Flux: the AI model that won't turn your princess into a Picasso painting! 😄 High-quality generation with detailed faces, hands with the perfect amount of fingers, and balanced compositions.
